_warning: Do not hand-edit. Run `npm run generate:taxonomy`.

descriptions.confirmshaming: Wording that shames or guilts you for declining.
descriptions.false_urgency: A deadline or countdown that may be fabricated or resetting.
descriptions.forced_action: Requires an unrelated action to proceed, such as signing up.
descriptions.obstruction: Makes an action harder than it needs to be, such as cancelling.
descriptions.scarcity: Claims limited stock or availability that may be unverifiable.
descriptions.sneaking: Slips in a charge, opt-in or condition you did not choose.
descriptions.social_proof: Unverifiable real-time activity used as peer pressure.
